summary: Phase 5 — Unified client communication hub /contact verified end-to-end. Backend endpoints were not retested (reused from prior phases per agent-to-agent note). Frontend Playwright on /contact with client 0x0errorr@gmail.com: header data-testid=contact-link present in client nav and routes to /contact; ContactPage renders the page heading 'Связь с администрацией' + all 4 tabs (contact-tab-chat/discounts/deferral/history all visible). CHAT tab: POST /api/chat/send fires when typing 'TEST_phase5_contact_<ts>' into contact-chat-input and clicking contact-chat-send; message appears right-aligned (teal) in contact-chat, persists after reload via GET /api/chat/messages, and shows up in admin /admin/chats sidebar (Максим entry, preview text matches). DISCOUNTS tab: contact-current-status renders 'Опт' (customer_status=wholesale), individual_discount=2% card visible, contact-discount-block + contact-status-block rendered, contact-status-partner button shown (wholesale-button correctly hidden because user is already wholesale — matches code `curStatus==='retail'`); contact-discount-percent/reason/submit form present (no pending discount_request). DEFERRAL tab: GET /api/credit/my returns status=approved, available=498169.4, debt=1830.6, pending_request=None — UI shows the three summary cards (Доступно / Долг / Срок) + contact-goto-credit button that navigates to /credit. HISTORY tab: contact-history container present with three labelled sections — 'Запросы скидок на товары' shows 1 entry history-disc-<id> (Hengst фильтр, индивидуальная цена 90 ₽, badge 'Одобрено'); 'Запросы товаров' shows 'Нет запросов' placeholder; 'Действующие индивидуальные цены' shows 'Нет индивидуальных цен' placeholder. Floating ChatWidget (bottom-left bubble) still present and shares messages with embedded chat (both hit /api/chat).

minor.issue: Returns 403 for client (non-admin) users — frontend swallows the error with .catch(() => {}), but the polling chat tab triggers this every 5s, producing repeated 403s in the network/console panel. Pre-existing; not introduced by Phase 5. Consider either gating the call to admin-only on the client side or accepting non-admin calls and no-oping server-side.

integration_issues.issue: When the global header promo banner 'Бонусная система с кешбэком до 10%' is showing, it overlays the top of the page and can intercept clicks on the tab strip — Playwright force=True clicks were swallowed (active tab did not change). Programmatic JS .click() works correctly and the underlying handlers fire normally. Real users would only see the issue if the popup happens to cover the tab buttons on small viewports. Consider z-index/positioning of the promo banner so it does not overlap the tab row, or dismissing it on /contact.

issues: An approved discount_request that has an individual_price (Hengst фильтр, 90 ₽) is shown in the 'Запросы скидок' section but does NOT appear under 'Действующие индивидуальные цены' — that section pulls from /api/individual-prices/my (separate collection). Either join the two server-side so approved individual prices show in both sections, or rename the third section ('Действующие индивидуальные цены') to make the source explicit. Pre-existing backend split, not a Phase 5 regression.

action_items: Decide on /api/chat/mark-read for non-admin clients — either make it a no-op (return 200) or skip the call on the client side to remove the recurring 403 noise.
Ensure the global promo banner ('Бонусная система с кешбэком до 10%') does not overlap the /contact tab strip (z-index / top offset). It currently intercepts pointer-events on the tab row.
(Pre-existing/optional) Consider merging /api/individual-prices/my with approved discount_requests that carry an individual_price so users see one consolidated list of active personalised prices.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactPage.js fetchChat polls every 5s and unconditionally calls POST /api/chat/mark-read — for non-admin users this 403s every poll cycle. Either guard with user.role==='admin' or change server behaviour to accept non-admin no-op.

ContactPage.js: tab content is rendered inside a single motion.div with `initial={{opacity:0}} animate={{opacity:1}}` but no per-tab key, so the fade-in animation only plays once (on first mount). Add `key={tab}` on the motion.div to get the intended cross-fade per tab switch.

ContactPage.js submitDiscount: enforces 1<percent<=50 client-side via Number(discPercent) > 50 — but the same input has `min='1' max='50'` HTML attributes, so the browser will already block out-of-range typing in some browsers. Inconsistent behaviour with the toast; keep one source of truth.

ContactPage.js: messages list does not show sender name/avatar — when admin replies, the client only sees a left-aligned grey bubble with the text. Consider showing 'Администратор' / staff avatar for clarity.

ContactPage.js — fetchRequests issues 5 parallel GETs on every mount; if any one fails the whole Promise.all rejects and silently swallows via try/catch (setMyReqs etc. never update). Use Promise.allSettled so a partial failure (e.g. credit/my 4xx for a brand-new user with no credit record) still populates the other tabs.

Discount-request submission shares the db.discount_requests collection with product-discount requests — POST /request-individual-discount returns 400 if ANY pending discount_request exists for the user (even a product-specific one). The Phase 5 UI presents this as just 'Ошибка' via the toast. Consider surfacing the existing pending product-discount in the discounts tab so the user understands why they cannot submit a new general one.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (chat send+persist+admin-visible, discounts/status content render, deferral approved-view + goto-credit, history with badges, floating ChatWidget intact); 1 design/overlay issue noted under integration_issues

seed_data_creation: Posted one TEST_phase5_contact_<timestamp> chat message from the client to admin via the embedded chat — remains in chat history as expected (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 data-testids that EXIST in ContactPage.js: contact-page, contact-link (Header.js), contact-tab-chat|discounts|deferral|history, contact-chat, contact-chat-input, contact-chat-send, contact-current-status, contact-discount-block, contact-discount-percent, contact-discount-reason, contact-discount-submit, contact-status-block, contact-status-wholesale (only when curStatus==='retail'), contact-status-partner (when curStatus!=='partner'), contact-deferral, contact-credit-block, contact-credit-limit, contact-credit-message, contact-credit-submit, contact-goto-credit, contact-history, history-disc-{id}, history-prod-{id}, history-price-{id}. KNOWN GOTCHA: the global promo banner can overlay the tab strip and intercept Playwright clicks — use page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('[data-testid="contact-tab-X"]').click()) for reliable tab switching in automation. The polling chat tab triggers POST /api/chat/mark-read every 5s which returns 403 for non-admin (silently caught). Test client 0x0errorr currently has: customer_status=wholesale, individual_discount=2%, approved credit (limit≈500k, available≈498169, debt≈1830), 1 approved product discount-request (Hengst, индивидуальная цена 90₽).
rca of the issue: N/A — Phase 5 feature works. The two issues observed are (a) a pre-existing 403 on POST /api/chat/mark-read for client users (silently swallowed by the frontend; noisy in console), and (b) the marketing promo banner overlapping the tab strip and intercepting force=True Playwright clicks (real-user clicks work because mouse-events go to the visible button; only synthetic force clicks are intercepted by overlay). Programmatic JS .click() proved the tab handlers and rendered content are all correct.
